summary: At the Skunk Works in [[location:epsilon-eridani]], [[character:bill]] quiets the room with an air-horn blast and welcomes everyone to the first Bob-moot, held in [[technology:vr]] on a matrix he has built there that is more than big enough for every Bob. When he calls them the Bobiverse, a name he has only just thought of, [[character:garfield]] objects that between that and [[organization:bobnet]] the galaxy may not be big enough for their ego. The turnout is modest: [[character:riker]], [[character:homer]] and the other clones from [[location:sol]], [[character:bart]] and his clones at [[location:alpha-centauri]], and the Bobs travelling with the colonists to [[location:omicron2-eridani]], who will drop out of touch in a month or so when their tau gets too high for VR. Bill hopes a few more Bobs will have picked up the [[technology:subspace-communications|SCUT]] plans and linked in by then. Over Homer's booing, he proposes making the moot a regular event to keep everyone up to date; Bart predicts it will be an excuse to inflict baseball on them, and Bill declines to answer. Then everyone moves to the pub VR for beer, coffee and a celebration.

updates.description: [[character:bill]]'s dedicated [[location:epsilon-eridani]] workshop for the new system's manufacturing and research work. Bill has built a matrix there that is more than big enough to run every Bob in [[technology:vr]], and it hosted the first Bob-moot in May 2172.

A virtual-reality interface developed aboard [[vessel:heaven-1]] to give a bodiless mind sensory input and an embodied experience; its software is still being refined. It provides convincing sensations, a humanlike avatar and shared environments such as libraries, parks and command decks, where users can create objects and play games. [[character:bill]] regards such embodied activity as important to keeping a human sense of self. Bill's upgrades let Bobs interact physically rather than only through video windows, and proprioception can be switched off. Bobs in different star systems can share a session, such as a virtual pub, but not while travelling at high tau.
